rowText.steps: Open Ollama tab -> vision try-order picker, press Done immediately with no reorder, read the settings file before and after.
rowText.expected: File should be unchanged if nothing moved; bug is that it gets rewritten anyway.

reads.action: Opened Settings > Set vision model try order..., only one model listed (gemma4:e2b-it-qat), moved the D-pad straight to Done without touching Up/Down, pressed A on Done.

verdictSentence: Pressing Done on the vision model order screen rewrote the settings file even though nothing was reordered -- the file's checksum and save time both changed -- so this still happens on the current build.
